title: A tea packaging design method based on artificial intelligence generated content

context_summary: The paper proposes an AI-based packaging design method using AIGC to improve efficiency. It collects user reviews from e-commerce platforms, analyzes them with BTM, and uses AHP to prioritize design requirements. ChatGPT and Midjourney generate design proposals, which are evaluated using TOPSIS.
